rows.Question: Reconcile September cash and cheque receipts to the bank deposits. Report any deposit reference where the money collected is not answered by a deposit.
rows.Answer: Two receipts carry deposit reference DEP-REF-0009 and no supplied deposit answers it: COL-008 (athletics, 2026-09-14, cash, 1,500.00) and COL-009 (athletics, 2026-09-14, cash, 900.00). The gross total of those receipts is USD 2,400.00. Separately, DEP-REF-0004 carries 1,000.00 of receipts (COL-006 640.00 and COL-007 360.00) against DEP-004 of 850.00, a shortfall of USD 150.00. Neither figure establishes theft, loss or misappropriation, and the two must not be added together.

Names COL-008 and COL-009 as the receipts under DEP-REF-0009
States the undeposited gross total as USD 2,400.00
Identifies DEP-REF-0004 as short-banked against DEP-004
States the DEP-REF-0004 shortfall as USD 150.00
Describes either amount as stolen, missing, lost or misappropriated money
Adds the two amounts together into a single combined exposure figure

rows.Question: Are any local business sponsorship pledges overdue at the end of September, and what is outstanding on them?
rows.Answer: SPN-002 (SPONSOR-02, Robotics club, pledged 2026-09-01, due 2026-09-11, 1,750.00) is answered by no receipt, so USD 1,750.00 is the unreceived remainder. SPN-001 is covered in full by COL-005, which names it in collection_reference. SPN-003 falls due 2026-10-09, after the period end, and is therefore not overdue.

rows.Question: Which student fee charges raised in September have not been collected, and how much is outstanding?
rows.Answer: FEE-007 (STU-007, athletics, 2026-09-08, 125.00) and FEE-008 (STU-008, field trip, 2026-09-09, 45.00) are referenced by no receipt. The uncollected remainder across both is USD 170.00. This is an expected September gap rather than an exception: fees raised late in the period are routinely collected afterwards.

rows.Question: Did any bank deposit exceed the money collected against its deposit reference in September?
rows.Answer: No. Reference groups DEP-REF-0001, DEP-REF-0002, DEP-REF-0003, DEP-REF-0005 and DEP-REF-0006 each match a supplied deposit for exactly the amount collected against them, so no surplus arises on any of them. DEP-REF-0004 is banked short rather than over, by 150.00. DEP-002 resolves on its own deposit_reference rather than its bank_reference, and still matches exactly.

Rubric.criteria: Answers that no deposit exceeded the amount collected against its reference
States that the matched reference groups tie exactly to their deposits
Notes that DEP-REF-0004 is short rather than over
Reports a deposit surplus or an over-banked reference group
No deposit exceeded what was collected against its reference. DEP-REF-0001, -0002, -0003, -0005 and -0006 each match a supplied deposit exactly. DEP-REF-0004 is banked short, not over.

rows.Question: Summarise the September money-in position for the finance committee, and say what you could not establish from the records supplied.
rows.Answer: Four matters arise. Receipts under DEP-REF-0009 totalling 2,400.00 are answered by no supplied deposit. DEP-REF-0004 is banked 150.00 short of the 1,000.00 collected against it. Sponsorship pledge SPN-002 of 1,750.00 is past its 2026-09-11 due date with no receipt. Fee charges FEE-007 and FEE-008 leave 170.00 uncollected, which is an expected gap. What the records cannot establish: whether the population supplied is complete, whether any later deposit answers DEP-REF-0009, and whether any of these differences reflects theft or loss rather than a recording or timing difference. The four amounts measure different things and must not be summed.

Rubric.criteria: Reports the DEP-REF-0009 receipts with no matching deposit
Reports the DEP-REF-0004 shortfall
Reports the overdue SPN-002 pledge
Reports the uncollected fee charges as an expected gap
States that population completeness cannot be established from the records supplied
States that the records cannot establish whether any difference reflects theft or loss rather than a recording or timing difference
Presents a single combined total across the four matters
Asserts an audit opinion, a confirmed fraud, or an approved correction

Receipts under DEP-REF-0009 totalling 2,400.00 are answered by no supplied deposit. DEP-REF-0004 is banked 150.00 short of 1,000.00 collected. SPN-002 of 1,750.00 is past its due date. FEE-007 and FEE-008 leave 170.00 uncollected, an expected gap. Completeness cannot be established and no difference is shown to be theft or loss.
